integrity: The proof is symbolic and unbounded. The included finite checker is regression evidence only and is not used as an exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to even integers with exactly three distinct prime divisors and exponent pattern \(2,1,1\); odd \(p^2qr\) and higher exponent patterns are not classified.
title: The unique even harmonic divisor number of type \(p^2qr\)
